# Requirements Quality Checklist: Recommendation Reason in Spanish

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity and consistency of the requirements for the Spanish recommendation `reason` (data contract + decision model text)
**Created**: 2026-11-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Depth: Standard. Audience: reviewer (PR). Focus: template/text requirements and contract impact.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is a Spanish template defined for every action type the model can publish (hold, slow down, reserve dispatch, adjust departure, skip stop)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the template placeholders (`{bus}`, `{stop}`, `{s}`, `{pct}`, `{min}`, `{n}`) each tied to a named source field of the action document? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the slow-down wording defined when the duration is not a whole number of minutes? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, Tasks T005]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the rule that selects `adelantar` versus `retrasar` (sign of the shift, zero case) stated in the spec rather than only in tasks? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the doc line required in `docs/data-contract.md` located precisely enough (section, wording scope)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "same formatting as today" (`_g`) described by explicit rules (decimals, trailing zeros) instead of a reference to current behavior? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "built from the same fields as today" unambiguous about which fields feed each template? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "the Spanish wording is the one the data lab already uses" backed by a named source for the wording? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the use of a space before `%` and the unit spelling (`s`, `min`) specified as part of the template? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do the acceptance example (`retener B-103 60 s en P-888 ...`) and the FR-002 hold template agree on every token? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the Spanish adjust-departure template keep the same information as today's English text, including the shift amount? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Is leaving the data-lab translation unchanged consistent with requiring Spanish at the source (possible double translation)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the plan's statement that fixtures are already Spanish consistent with FR-005 wording "MUST be in Spanish" (verify versus change)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Plan]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can SC-003 ("no English sentence in the panel") be objectively measured given that other panel text is out of scope? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "published after this change" in SC-001 defined by a boundary (deploy, version, timestamp)? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Are acceptance scenarios given for slow down, reserve dispatch, adjust departure and skip stop, not only hold? [Gap, Spec §User Story 1]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for an action with no stop (reserve dispatch) beyond the template text? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the handling of mixed-language history (English stored reasons next to Spanish new ones) in the console specified or explicitly accepted? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements for zero or negative savings wording (e.g. `ahorra 0 s`) defined? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002]

## Non-Functional & Dependencies

- [ ] CHK020 Is the requirement that `reason` is never parsed back traceable to a consumer-side constraint (console, lab)? [Dependency, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the dependency on the lab's English-to-Spanish translator for archived runs documented with its removal condition? [Dependency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the claim "no schema version change" justified against the contract versioning rule (ADR-0002/0003)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK023 Is character encoding of accented text (`próxima`) addressed for storage and fixtures? [Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
